trigger: Reach Augie's radio shack on Peavine Peak.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A shack under the repeater towers, wrapped in foil insulation. Inside: a woodstove, six radios, two old men.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Sparks! My ears in Sparks! Come in, shut the door. Augie Bell. This is Walt. Walt, be nice.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: The big rig's down. Final's cooked. Somebody said there's a kid in Sparks who fixes airplanes.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Your name on the air, a cup of something hot, and the best gossip in the Great Basin.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A blown output tube and a cracked solder joint. Twenty minutes. Augie keys up and almost cries.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: This is KK7AUG, back on the air with a NEW final, courtesy of a genuine United States Air Force crew chief!

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: ...Between us? Half the good news I read is made up. Korea ships? I made that up. People need it.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: It's hope with a little extra salt. Walt thinks I'm going to hell. Walt, tell him.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: He's going to hell. ...You're Pearce. Turbines. Avila's people say you know turbines.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Walt Okada. I ran the control room at Galena Station twenty-two years. The geothermal plant. Steamboat.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: The wells don't care about the grid. Water comes up at three hundred twenty degrees whether America exists or not.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: But you can't start the plant cold. Pumps, controls, the cooling fans. You need outside power to wake it up.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Black start. You need a generator big enough to spin the pumps.

choices.text: I know where there's a ground power cart.
Why haven't you done it already?

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: [Coughs for a long time.] Lungs. Forty years of hydrogen sulfide. I can tell you. I can't climb.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Air Guard ramp at the airport. Ninety-kilowatt carts for the C-130s. One of those would do it. Barely.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Galena's warm. Galena could heat a hospital. Maybe half of Reno. Who do you tell?
